title: Premiums to general fund.
bodyText: The premiums received from the sale of any bonds issued pursuant to this part shall be a realization of the general fund of the State.
bodyHtml: §39-6  Premiums to general fund.  The premiums received from the sale of any bonds issued pursuant to this part shall be a realization of the general fund of the State. [L 1988, c 28, pt of §3]
